intent: A fen-mourning Victorian gown: a pale mist-grey bodice and pale sleeves pinched by a narrow willow sash over a full bell skirt that flares from the waist, with long willow strands, a black lace cap and short veil, and cold wisp-blue dew, so the high camera reads a pale A-line bride under a black-veiled head.
